name: Raini Wine Cabinet
description: Beautifully crafted with an aluminum frame for a vintage aviator feel, this Raini wine cabinet features plenty of builtin wine storage. This piece will look fantastic against a wall in any lounge, kitchen, or dining room and it could be matched well with other industrialinspired furniture. When you have a party with friends and family, this cart could be mobilized to serve your guests. It is builtin with a 23bottle wine rack, perfect for wine enthusiasts. Great design is as much about style as it is about functionality. This wine cabinet, mounted on wheels with locking breaks, makes a fantastic addition to any home bar, kitchen, or entertainment area.

description: Introducing the ultimate wine cabinet for the modern connoisseur our stunning Yoela wine cabinet. The black iron legs with a gold metal tip not only add to the aesthetic appeal of the cabinet, but also provide a sturdy foundation for your prized wine collection. The cabinet boasts ample storage space with shelves to accommodate bottles of all sizes.
